'''Weng Wrightsyn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen living on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He felt that justice wasn't being applied by the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|Security Forces]] and that killers ran free, so he asked a traveler to investigate.

==Biography==
{{GameDSmechanics}}
In [[3643 BBY]], a series of murders took place in [[Kaas City]], and he claimed to have seen the killer in the act. Calling on a passing individual to investigate the murderer, a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Renegin]], to investigate.

Renegin informed the individual of his job, tagging people for a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith]] game, and that he was looking to escape [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] after those he tagged started [[Death/Legends|dying]]. Renegin convinced the individual to tag Wrightsyn to silence him.
{{Endgame}}
